products.name: Mastra Factory
products.tagline: From issue to production, run by agents.
products.description: Mastra Factory is an open source, agent-powered software delivery environment. It combines persistent coding agents, repository workspaces, issue intake, planning, implementation, and pull request review in a web application you control.

products.name: Harden
products.tagline: A security layer for AI coding agents
products.description: Harden AIF is a free, local security tool for AI coding agents. Its post-trained model checks tool calls before they run, using your request and session context. It beat frontier models on key agent-security benchmarks, while keeping your repo and tool output on your machine.

products.name: ChatGPT Images 2.5
products.tagline: Sharper visuals, faster flow, better creative control
products.description: ChatGPT Images 2.5 is OpenAI's next-generation image model built for sharper details, faster generation, and more precise editing. It helps you turn sketches, prompts, and reference photos into polished visuals with better consistency, natural lighting, richer textures, and stronger control across every edit.

products.name: Noodle Seed
products.tagline: Your product in AI and AI in your product
products.description: Noodle Seed helps software teams make their products ready for AI agents. Build workflows in TypeScript, expose them through a secure branded assistant inside your product, and make the same capabilities available to external agents. Instead of stitching together MCP SDKs and hosting infrastructure, Noodle Seed provides the governed runtime for identity, permissions, secrets, audit, and operations.

products.name: Muse by Meta
products.tagline: Your personal AI agent that gets things done
products.description: Try Muse, your personal AI agent that gets things done. Give Muse a goal or an everyday task and it handles the rest, from finances and health to shopping and the people you care about.

products.name: Ass Auction
products.tagline: Brands outbid each other to put their logo on my ass
products.description: Ass Auction is an ad network with one placement: a pair of boxers. Pay $5 or more and your logo joins the leaderboard at whatever rank your money buys. Anyone can pay more and push you down. Your total spend is your rank, so climbing back only costs the difference. The top 22 get worn on the boxers. No accounts, just a URL or X handle, and Stripe. Live click counts, a share card, an email when you get knocked down, and a gossip bar where the crowd talks.

products.name: AlphaGenome Atlas
products.tagline: Google's AI map of every possible human DNA mutation
products.description: AlphaGenome Atlas is Google DeepMind's AI-powered map of how genetic mutations may affect human biology. Built by precomputing AlphaGenome predictions for all 9 billion possible single-letter DNA changes, the 1-petabyte dataset lets researchers explore and prioritize variants across both coding and non-coding regions. It's free to explore through a visual web interface, with API and Antigravity access for deeper research.

products.name: DuckFightClub
products.tagline: Train your MicroDuck and win the Golden Beak Belt
products.description: Imagine WWE SmackDown, but with cute, AI-trained robots. Eight teams spend days training reinforcement-learning policies for Pollen’s open-source MicroDuck, then we throw them in the simulator to fight for the Golden Beak Belt. The whole competition will be livestreamed. The catch: you’re not building a robot, you’re training its brain. Want in? Register a team, train your policy, or host a showdown in your city. When the real MicroDucks ship, we go IRL.

products.name: 49agents IDE
products.tagline: 2D IDE for running agents across projects without fatigue
products.description: 49Agents IDE is a 2D canvas where every agent, terminal, repo and machine you own lives on a single map that you build yourself. 49 leverages how our brains are wired to solve tab navigation fatigue problem for 10x Engineers - because of the citybuilder-like UX, it becomes effortless to associate processes to tabs, even when you come back to them days later.

products.name: GoModel
products.description: Open-source AI gateway in Go. One OpenAI-compatible API for every provider, with budgets, caching, guardrails, load balancing, and failover. Single binary, ~20MB docker image MIT, bring your own keys. A self-hosted alternative to OpenRouter and LiteLLM.

products.name: Type.com
products.tagline: A shared workspace for Claude, Codex, and your team
products.description: Type is a shared workspace that compounds your team's best AI work. Connect tools once, use any model, and put skills, files, and threads in one place your whole team can see. Build custom apps and automations on a company brain that gets smarter as you work.

products.name: Diiverge
products.tagline: Turn any picture into a playable AI adventure
products.description: Turn a photo, painting or screenshot into a point-and-click adventure. Click something in the scene, choose what happens, and AI creates the next scene and a short film of the moment. Every path is saved, so others can explore the branches you create. Play the public worlds for free, or buy scene packs in the studio to make your own adventure and share it with a link.

products.name: Basedash in Español Français & Português
products.tagline: Work with your data in your language
products.description: Basedash is now available in English, Español, Français, and Português. Choose a language in profile settings and the entire interface switches instantly—no page reload, no interrupted flow. Only your selected language loads, keeping the app snappy while dashboards, chats, automations, and settings resolve in the words you know. Switch back any time. Four languages, one fast interface. Work with your data in your language.

products.name: AdScope
products.tagline: Understand your ad performance in seconds
products.description: AdScope transforms confusing ad data into clear visual dashboards for agencies and business owners. We display your actual ad creatives right next to the metrics that matter most. During onboarding, you define your business type like e commerce or lead generation, and your main overview adapts instantly. Campaign metrics also adjust dynamically based on campaign type. This creates total transparency and builds instant trust. Stop guessing and understand your ad performance in five seconds.

products.name: WorkID.ai
products.tagline: Where verified talent meets opportunity. Hire with trust!
products.description: We've rebuilt the way hiring works. Hiring still runs on self-claims. A CV says whatever someone types into it, and the recruiter has to take it on faith, so candidates send out a hundred applications and hear nothing back. On WorkID you verify your identity and work experience. Companies see a profile that has been checked, not a list of claims, and the vetting is done before the first screening. We then match you to the roles you actually fit. Free to start. For hiring globally.
